aliases: Habitat Real Estate Partners Project Ruby
status_as_of_cutoff: local process: private proposed hyperscale data-center campus with Columbus/Choose Columbus project materials and a citywide Technology Overlay ordinance process advanced in 2026. The Technology Overlay regulates possible data-center zoning but is not itself Project Ruby site approval. End user remains undisclosed; no project-specific rezoning approval, building/land-disturbance permit, construction, certificate of occupancy, executed utility interconnection, or energization was verified.
evidence_grade: B: official Choose Columbus/Development Authority materials and Columbus Council agenda/minutes verify ownership/process/overlay actions; capacity remains sourced to local media/industry trackers rather than an official filing found in this refresh.

actions.government_body: Choose Columbus / Development Authority project materials
actions.result_status: Public project map depicted a proposed Project Ruby data-center site, phase-one campus, buildings, substation, and property boundary; it did not constitute a zoning or construction approval.
actions.access_caveat: Authority/developer material; map is conceptual and not an issued permit or parcel deed.

actions.government_body: Development Authority of Columbus / Choose Columbus
actions.result_status: Authority announced a proposed technology center campus with Habitat Partners; the customer/end user was not named and no local vote or approval was claimed in the announcement.
actions.access_caveat: Economic-development announcement, not a rezoning, site-plan, building, environmental, or utility approval.
actions.evidence_note: Sponsor/authority announcement kept separate from government permitting.

actions.government_body: City of Columbus / Choose Columbus project information
actions.result_status: Project page describes the sequence for a proposed technology overlay, subsequent rezoning request, and DRI process; it does not state that those steps were completed for Project Ruby.
actions.access_caveat: Public FAQ/process page; draft overlay language is not an enacted ordinance.

actions.result_status: PAC considered REZN-02-26-0289 on March 4 and March 18, 2026 and recommended conditional approval by a 5-1 vote, including a 500-foot buffer condition.
actions.access_caveat: Council packet/staff report; recommendation concerns the citywide Technology Overlay text amendment, not project-specific rezoning approval.

actions.result_status: Council agenda listed REZN-02-26-0289 for first reading to amend the UDO to provide for Technology Overlay Districts and redefine DRIs.
actions.access_caveat: Agenda item/first reading; not a site-specific approval.

actions.action_type: technology overlay ordinance continued first reading and amendments
actions.result_status: Council agenda continued REZN-02-26-0289 on first reading as amended by substitute; post-summary minutes report public hearing held and amendments including 500-foot buffers, PFAS-related cooling-fluid language, generator restrictions, and decibel testing.
actions.access_caveat: Summary minutes for citywide overlay ordinance; not a Project Ruby rezoning, land-disturbance permit, or building permit.

actions.result_status: Council adopted Ordinance 26-034 / REZN-02-26-0289 by a six-to-two vote; council discussion stated the Technology Overlay District is a planning and zoning tool for future technology-related development and not a vote on a specific data-center project.
actions.access_caveat: Official council packet/minutes; ordinance is citywide overlay, not site-specific Project Ruby approval.
actions.evidence_note: Overlay adoption changes regulatory context but does not verify construction or permits.

actions.government_body: Georgia Department of Community Affairs / regional DRI process, as reported by Columbus Ledger-Enquirer
actions.result_status: Local reporting says Project Ruby moved to DRI review after Columbus Council approved data-center rules, while noting several steps remained before the project could proceed.
actions.access_caveat: Ledger-Enquirer article was visible in search results but direct fetch returned 403; no official DCA Project Ruby record was located during this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Use as secondary evidence only until DCA/regional commission file is directly verified.

capacity_mw_note: 600 MW is reported by regional/industry trackers and local reporting snippets as a power request or planned capacity; official Choose Columbus materials reviewed here did not publish a MW capacity, and one Realtor.com/Ledger-derived report states 650 MW.
owner: Muscogee Property 1, LLC; Choose Columbus states it is owned/managed by Habitat Partners.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Official Dec. 1, 2025 Choose Columbus site map labels the property boundary as 985 acres; GPB/Ledger reporting on May 4, 2026 describes an April 9 map/site as 865 acres; Cleanview lists 875 acres and DataCenterMap lists 987 acres. Treat acreage as unresolved until parcel or rezoning filing is verified.
Most secondary sources reviewed report 600 MW, while Realtor.com/Ledger-derived reporting states 650 MW. Official Choose Columbus pages reviewed during this refresh did not publish a MW figure.
